✨ Luxury Waterfront Living at Quaywest II – Furnished 2 Bed + Den | 2 Bath ✨


Welcome to Quaywest II, one of Yaletown’s most sought-after waterfront residences! This fully furnished 2 bedroom + den, 2 bathroom suite offers over 1,200 sq. ft. of beautifully designed living space with breathtaking south-facing water views.

Step inside to enjoy hardwood floors, a gas stove, in-suite washer & dryer, and a private balcony – perfect for relaxing or entertaining. 🏢 Building Amenities:

Fully equipped fitness centre
24/7 concierge service
Indoor swimming pool
Hot tub
Guest parking
Secure bike storage

Water, hydro, & gas
1 underground parking stall w/ EV charging capabilites
📌 Details:
Fully furnished
Minimum 6-month rental, long-term lease preferred
Sorry, no pets
$100 strata move-in fee applies
